scoring: author and independent per question; original xlsxwriter/pandas prediction-column round trip; AI2D local fixed parser
gating: entire panel acceptance and independent review with clean supervisor exits before reading any generated output or reference
look: Second exploratory look after first DEV oracle scoring; separately report this batch; no predeclared pooled estimate.

stopping_rule: Report upper 95% interval < 1pp for each contrast only as the frozen threshold; r16 result does not imply equivalence for r8 or all settings.
